sheets.title: Photon — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Before: nothing was known about Photon, so its page offered the generic OAuth form with every endpoint blank. After: Photon's documented OAuth 2.1 server (app.photon.codes), S256 PKCE required, where to register the app, and its scopes with what each grants.
sheets.before: generic OAuth form: 14 inputs, 1 checkbox, 1 link to photon.codes
sheets.after: Photon's server filled in: 30 inputs, 17 checkboxes (16 scopes), 3 links to photon.codes

sheets.title: Photon scopes — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: The scope list a person chooses from, defaults ticked; the token proof reads the account from Photon's own userinfo endpoint.
sheets.after: 16 scopes with their meaning, 5 ticked by default

sheets.title: Similarweb on a phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Similarweb's MCP server publishes no OAuth metadata and takes a key. Before: an empty instructions field. After: Similarweb's own steps to generate and activate a key, pre-filled, and the key proven against user-capabilities (a call that costs no credits).
sheets.before: 0 links to Similarweb's docs; instructions empty
sheets.after: 2 links to Similarweb's docs; instructions pre-filled
